Selenite Tower intro — 1 actionable defect:

1. `scripts/narrative/intro_cutscene.gd::_finish_intro` failure path breaks retry: sets `AdvanceButton.text="TENTAR DE NOVO"` but `AdvanceButton` still calls `_advance_dialogue`, which early-returns if `not _wake_finished` or `not last beat`. After mid-dialogue `Skip` failure, `Advance` advances dialogue instead of retrying lobby.
Fix: add `_load_failed` flag set on `change_scene_to_file(LOBBY_PATH)!=OK`, cleared on `_set_beat`; make `_advance_dialogue` call `_finish_intro` when flag set.

Verified OK: Godot 4 syntax, `@onready` paths match `tscn`, `hframes`/tween/`set_border_width_all`/`get_global_transform_with_canvas` usage, keyboard Enter/Space + panel-click advance, Skip unlock 0.55s, `SceneTree` meta single-view per session, no `FileAccess`/`ConfigFile` save, `INTRO_PATH`/`LOBBY_PATH` consistent, manifest art+`source/.gdignore`+`.lua`/`.aseprite` present.
